supersession_rule: ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-001 and ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-002 are preserved unedited as the historical locks of record. This revision amends only the rows named in `amendments`. Everything else carries forward unchanged and is incorporated by reference.
revision_reason: Chairman render directive of 2026-09-17 registered REF-05 and introduced one new locked value not present in LOCK-001 or LOCK-002: a permitted colour read for defender uniforms. Recorded as a revision rather than an in-place edit.

amendments.lock_002_text: Defenders 4-6, white jerseys, visibly aligned in coverage; plain jersey numbers permitted; no callout boxes; never reuse 3, 4, 7, 8, 22
amendments.chairman_directive: Defender uniforms may visually read as white jerseys with blue accents and blue helmets, but no NFL logo, no Colts horseshoe, no copied player likeness.
amendments.resolution: LOCK-003 value: defenders wear white jerseys with blue accents and blue helmets. Count, coverage posture, plain numbering, no callout boxes and the forbidden numerals 3/4/7/8/22 all carry forward unchanged.
amendments.rights_guard: LOCK-11 and CR-12 are unchanged and remain absolute. The permitted colour read is a palette permission only. No league mark, no club mark, no horseshoe or other club device, no helmet logo of any kind, no player likeness. Colour may evoke a city palette; marks may not be reproduced.
amendments.risk_note: RISK-01 — a white-and-blue American-football uniform is the single highest rights-hygiene risk surface in this edition. Any render carrying this permission must be swept at 300 percent across every helmet shell, sleeve, chest and pant stripe before acceptance.

registered_references_added.observed: sepia-toned painterly interior night scene, heavy visible brushwork and grain, lamplit background figures, strong chiaroscuro, warm monochrome cast
registered_references_added.authority: IMAGERY LANGUAGE ONLY — painterly, textured, cinematic human editorial illustration
registered_references_added.chairman_statement: REF-05 governs imagery language only: painterly, textured, cinematic human editorial illustration. It does not govern subject matter or brown color cast.
registered_references_added.consistency: matches LOCK-07 and CR-10 as already written; no amendment required. Its registration closes the last outstanding reference slot but adds no new permission.

rule: The next render cites lock_id ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-003 and satisfies every lock carried forward from ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-001 and ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-002 plus AM-06. Prior locks are not edited. A change to any value locked here is ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-004. Nothing is published; the preview rail stands.
